effective_date_reading: Sec. 3 says 'Executive Order No. 11189 of November 23, 1964, Executive Order No. 11195 of January 30, 1965, and Executive Order No. 11995 of June 8, 1977 are revoked.' The whole order (secs. 1-3) has no effective-date wording, so the revocations took effect on signing, May 15, 1978 (printed 43 FR 21315, May 17, 1978).

targets_in_batch_06.EO:11189: sec. 3 ('Executive Order No. 11189 of November 23, 1964'); whole order, no qualifier. BLOCKED in this batch: an OFR editorial note says 80 Stat. 460, 461 (5 U.S.C. 5315, 5316) nullified it earlier by including every position it added.
targets_in_batch_06.EO:11195: sec. 3 ('Executive Order No. 11195 of January 30, 1965'); whole order, no qualifier. BLOCKED for the same reason as EO 11189 (the OFR note names EO 11195's positions too).

conclusion: EO 12060 (signed 1978-05-15, 43 FR 21315, PDF page 19, read once in full) amends EO 11861 (secs. 1-2: adds one level IV position, changes one title, deletes one level V position) and in sec. 3 revokes EO 11189, EO 11195 and EO 11995 by number. It has no savings, pending-matter, transfer or effective-date wording. The 'inserting in lieu thereof' wording in sec. 1 is a title substitution inside EO 11861, not a transfer of functions.
